findings.claim: At this head the new classification block tells the agent to "Run the Classify step of the role-chain skill for each" result, but the role-chain skill has no Classify step. Any agent that stops on a branch with stored results that have kept findings, in a repository with no docs/wiki/evidence.md (this repository has none), is blocked once per session and result with an order it cannot carry out. The step only arrives with T4b, which has not been started. If this head is delivered or deployed before T4b, every such stop costs an extra turn on a dead-end instruction.

Read engine/cmd/review_stop_hook.go L48-185: runReviewStopHook prints the oneLine error on stderr and then the block on stdout, always with exit 0, and the panic is recovered. The oneLine/controlAt ordering puts line breaks before controls and writes valid multi-byte UTF-8 whole.
